upbeat.name: Street tacos
upbeat.explanation: Bright toppings like lime, salsa, and pickled onion, and they're easy to order a round of and share when you're feeling social.

upbeat.name: Poke bowl
upbeat.explanation: Colorful, build-your-own, and quick to grab, so it keeps pace with a busy, good-mood day instead of slowing it down.

upbeat.name: Korean fried chicken
upbeat.explanation: Crunchy, saucy, and made for splitting with friends: a fun order for celebrating a day that went well.

calm.name: Ramen
calm.explanation: A warm bowl you eat slowly, which suits an unhurried evening when you have time to sit and enjoy it.

calm.name: Mediterranean mezze
calm.explanation: Hummus, pita, falafel, and olives are small plates you can graze on at your own pace without any rush.

calm.name: Café soup and sandwich
calm.explanation: A simple, familiar café lunch that pairs well with a book or a quiet corner and doesn't ask much of you.

stressed.name: Mac and cheese
stressed.explanation: Familiar and predictable, so there are no surprises to think about when your head is already full.

stressed.name: Pizza by the slice
stressed.explanation: Fast, inexpensive, easy to find near campus, and easy to eat one-handed while you keep working through a deadline.

stressed.name: Burrito bowl
stressed.explanation: One order covers a full meal with a few quick choices, so you can stop deciding about food and get back to what's on your plate.

low-energy.name: Pho
low-energy.explanation: Arrives ready to eat and is mostly hands-off: add herbs and lime if you feel like it, then just sip.

low-energy.name: Chicken and rice platter
low-energy.explanation: One container, one fork, and widely available for pickup or delivery when cooking feels like too much.

low-energy.name: Bagel sandwich
low-energy.explanation: Quick to grab, takes a few minutes to eat, and keeps fine if you only finish half now and save the rest.

adventurous.name: Ethiopian
adventurous.explanation: Stews and vegetables served on injera and eaten by hand from a shared platter, a different way of eating if you haven't tried it.

adventurous.name: Sichuan
adventurous.explanation: Sichuan peppercorns bring a tingly, numbing heat alongside chili that tastes unlike most everyday takeout.

adventurous.name: Peruvian
adventurous.explanation: Dishes like ceviche and lomo saltado blend Andean, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese influences in one cuisine.
